title: Pt-heptamer
unit_source: The harness counts every force call on the band. The eOn report.sh divides each band total by the 8 moving images and prints it with %.0f, and the GMAN opt.py divides by 8.0 and prints the mean with %d. J. Chem. Phys. 128, 134106 (2008) tabulates force calls per image. Eight times a rounded per-image mean differs from the band total, so the archived rows keep their own unit.
